verdict.rationale: Zoho Books' API is clearly versioned (v3 in all endpoints, e.g. https://www.zohoapis.com/books/v3) and comprehensively documented with OAuth, rate limits, and a downloadable OpenAPI spec, giving AI-native developers a stable, machine-readable contract to build against. However, no evidence in the pack shows a documented deprecation policy, versioning changelog, or sunset/migration timeline for older API versions. Missing for 10: explicit deprecation/versioning policy documentation, changelog of breaking changes, sunset timelines for prior versions, independent confirmation of policy adherence.
